title: Temperance choice fixture
premise: Exercise sobriety, two endings and a fully viable abstaining path.

opening.text: This compact tavern fixture tests a bounded sobriety choice without depicting a historical patron or conversation. Both the drink and the abstaining alternative are invented mechanics, not claims about conduct in this building.

stops.text: Pause outside and choose how the fictional outing ends. Taking a drink lowers the declared sobriety resource by one; choosing water changes nothing and remains a complete, first-class path through the story.

choices.label: Take a drink
choices.consequence: Sobriety falls by one within its declared bounds.

choices.label: Choose water
choices.consequence: Sobriety stays unchanged; abstaining is always viable.

endings.text: The fictional outing records the one-drink ending.
The fictional outing records the abstaining ending.

keepsake.title: A Clear Choice
keepsake.text: A test keepsake for the fictional tavern path.

evidence.text: The patron, drink, water, sobriety value, choices and alternate endings are invented test content rather than claims about anyone at the tavern.
